comments.author: daveplx
comments.body_html:
I really like the idea. Unfortunately, I also had the issue of the grenades disappearing. I didn’t see the explosion and it didn’t sound like it was where I threw but I definitely heard an explosion somewherewhen I threw a grenade.

Apart from that, it currently appears to take out and throw a grenade upon releasing the key, right?

Could you change it in the following way?

Holding G takes out a grenade, pulls the pun and goes into “prepare to throw” animation/mode - where the arm is held back but you can wait before you throw.

If you could use the base behavior in that regard, it would probably work with the “cooking grenades” mod, which allows to start cooking the grenade when in that mode.

“Pressing” G would simply be a very short / unnoticeable “hold” then.

Please don’t feel obligated, these are just proposals which would lead me to use the mod (apart from the throw bug being fixed)

Edit: Maybe the idea of “staranew” is even better, where pressing G would immediately start cooking the grenade as well if cooking grenades mod is present.
